scope: Real 4D 20.8 synthetic native-array grid with an expensive pending-action scope callback, macOS 26.6.2 on Apple Silicon.
change: Skip the scroll and extra confirmation callback when the selected row is already visible. All existing timeout, identity, permission and application-handler checks remain.
